shellCommands.command: cd /workspace && git status --short && git log --oneline | head -5 && cat package.json && ls && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -path ./.next -prune -o -type f \( -name '*.ts' -o -name '*.tsx' -o -name '*.js' -o -name '*.mjs' \) -print

cd /workspace && git diff; for f in next.config.ts app/*.tsx app/*/page.tsx tsconfig.json; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done; head -50 __agent_eval__/run.mjs; cat node_modules/next/package.json | grep '"version"'
cd /workspace/node_modules/next && ls dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rl "cacheComponents" dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head -20

cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs && f=$(grep -rl "Migrating route segment config\|force-dynamic" . | head -5); echo "$f"; grep -rn -B2 -A25 "### \`dynamic = \"force-dynamic\"\`\|### \`revalidate\`" 01-app/01-getting-started/*cache-components* 2>/dev/null | head -120
cd /workspace && git switch -c cache-components 2>&1; npx next build 2>&1 | tail -40; echo EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
